chosen:
local Scheduler = {}
Scheduler.__index = Scheduler

function Scheduler.new()
    return setmetatable({
        tasks = {},
        task_id = 0
    }, Scheduler)
end

function Scheduler:spawn(fn, ...)
    self.task_id = self.task_id + 1
    local id = self.task_id
    local co = coroutine.create(fn)
    local args = {...}
    self.tasks[id] = {
        co = co,
        args = args,
        active = true
    }
    return id
end

function Scheduler:step()
    local completed = {}
    local ran_any = false
    for id, task in pairs(self.tasks) do
        if task.active and coroutine.status(task.co) ~= 'dead' then
            ran_any = true
            local ok, err = coroutine.resume(task.co, table.unpack(task.args or {}))
            task.args = nil -- clear initial args
            if not ok then
                task.active = false
                error(string.format("Task %d failed: %s", id, tostring(err)))
            end
            if coroutine.status(task.co) == 'dead' then
                table.insert(completed, id)
            end
        end
    end
    for _, id in ipairs(completed) do
        self.tasks[id] = nil
    end
    return ran_any
end

return Scheduler

local function memoize(fn)
    local cache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = 'k' }) -- weak keys to allow garbage collection
    return function(...)
        local args = {...}
        local key = ''
        for i = 1, select('#', ...) do
            key = key .. tostring(args[i]) .. ':' .. type(args[i]) .. '|'
        end
        if cache[key] ~= nil then
            return cache[key]
        end
        local result = fn(...)
        cache[key] = result
        return result
    end
end

return memoize

local function parse_url(url)
    if type(url) ~= 'string' or #url == 0 then return nil, 'invalid url' end

    local scheme, rest = url:match('^([%a][%w%+%.%-]*)://(.*)$')
    if not scheme then return nil, 'missing scheme' end

    local authority, path_query = rest:match('^([^/]+)(/?.*)$')
    if not authority then authority, path_query = rest, '/' end
    if path_query == '' then path_query = '/' end

    local path, query = path_query:match('^([^?]*)(%??.*)$')
    if query and query:sub(1,1) == '?' then query = query:sub(2) else query = nil end

    local host, port
    local h, p = authority:match('^([^:]+):(%d+)$')
    if h and p then
        host, port = h, tonumber(p)
    else
        host, port = authority, (scheme == 'https' and 443 or (scheme == 'http' and 80 or nil))
    end

    return {
        scheme = string.lower(scheme),
        host = string.lower(host),
        port = port,
        path = path,
        query = query
    }
end

return parse_url
